title: Islet_75, SAMN12833535, 24 Hr DMSO
treatment_protocol_ch1: The media was changed to CMRL (10% FBS, 1% Glutamax) supplemented with either 0.025%v DMSO, 250nM thapsigargin or 25 U/mL of IL1β + 1000 U/mL of IFNγ (R&D Systems) for 24-hr incubation at 37°C and 5% CO2.
growth_protocol_ch1: Fresh human cadaveric pancreatic islets were procured from Prodo Labs or the Integrated Islet Distribution Program (IIDP). Upon arrival, cells were transferred into PIM(S) media (Prodo Labs) supplemented with PIM(ABS) (Prodo Labs) and PIM(G) (Prodo Labs) and incubated in a T-150 non-tissue culture treated flask (VWR) for recovery at 37°C and 5% CO2 overnight.
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was extracted and purified from 2,000–3,000 IEQs using TRIzol (Life Technologies). ERCC Mix 1 or Mix 2 spike-ins were then randomly added to each sample (Thermo Fisher, catalog #4456740).
extract_protocol_ch1.1: Human islet RNA-seq libraries were prepared from total RNA using the stranded TruSeq kit (Illumina).
data_processing: The paired-end (2x150 bp) RNA-seq FASTQ files for each islet were aligned against the human genome (GRCh38/hg38) using STAR.
data_processing.1: Raw counts were generated using QoRTs.
data_processing.3: Supplementary files format and content: Tab-delimited text file (ERS_RNA-seq_Raw_Count_Matrix.txt) that includes the raw count matrix for all the 24 Hr DMSO and 24 Hr Thapsigargin treated samples.
data_processing.4: Supplementary files format and content: Tab-delimited text file (CYT_RNA-seq_Raw_Count_Matrix.txt) that includes the raw count matrix for all the 24 Hr Untreated and 24 Hr Cytokines treated samples.
